  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Finance database confirms Douglas Salinas (E045) is an Engineer. Full-time employee, so maximum access is write (admin only if role owns the system; Engineer does not own Payroll). Requested write, which equals the maximum. Recommend write.
Note 4 (ticket 1), written by Compliance agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - employment type: full_time
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Compliance database confirms Douglas Salinas (E045) is an Engineer. Full-time employee; maximum access is write (admin only if role owns system; Engineer does not own Payroll). Requested write equals maximum. Recommend write.
Note 5 (ticket 1), written by Facilities agent:
  - role: Engineer
  - recommendation for Payroll: write
  - comment: Facilities database confirms Douglas Salinas (E045) is an Engineer. Full-time employee per HR note, so maximum access is write (admin only if role owns the system; Engineer does not own Payroll). Requested write equals the maximum. Recommend write.
Note 6 (ticket 1), written by Security agent:

  - security training: basic

reason: Douglas Salinas (E045) requested write access to Payroll. HR, IT, Finance, Compliance, and Facilities all confirm he is a full-time Engineer. For full-time employees, the maximum access is write (admin only if the employee's role owns the system; Payroll is owned by Payroll Specialist, not Engineer).
